hero.subtitle: A content system for companies, online shops and agencies. One topic becomes every format, each one tailored to its channel.

visual_demo.heading: One topic. Six formats. Every channel.

modules.heading: What PRIZMA produces
modules.subheading: Publishing regularly is no longer enough. Algorithms weigh consistency, topical relevance and how people behave. PRIZMA builds the formats you need from a single topic, each one tuned to its channel.

items.name: Post
items.desc: A post that shows what your company can do. Not just an image, but a statement that stays in mind and builds trust.

items.name: Reel
items.desc: Short-form video with a clear message. The platforms distribute it organically. The most direct route to new reach, with no ad budget.

items.name: Carousel
items.desc: Complex ideas, broken down clearly. Carousels earn saves and shares. The kind of content people bookmark and come back to.

items.name: Story
items.desc: Short and current. Stories keep your channels present between the larger posts and are usually seen first.

items.name: Article
items.desc: An article that brings visitors for years. PRIZMA evaluates real search queries and structures the text for good placement.

items.name: Avatar
items.desc: A face for your brand, with no camera and no shoot. The AI avatar delivers your script on video, regularly and at consistent quality.

why.heading: From topic to publication
why.text: Most tools deliver text. Everything after that stays your job. PRIZMA covers the whole process: one topic becomes the formats you need, aimed at real search queries and your region. Publication runs through your channels, and the results feed into the next round of planning. Every text is adapted to the way your company writes. Approval stays with you.

items.title: Travel agencies
items.desc: Offers stay visible continuously, without anyone preparing them one by one.

items.title: Online shops
items.desc: Products get content that sells and gets found in search.

items.title: Hotels and hospitality
items.desc: A steady presence on every channel while the team stays with the guest.

items.title: Schools and kindergartens
items.desc: Parents stay informed, in one consistent voice and with no extra workload.

items.title: Manufacturing and trade
items.desc: Know-how from the business becomes content that customers find and understand.

items.title: Agencies and resellers
items.desc: Several client brands from one system, each with its own voice.

steps.title: Topic
steps.desc: A product, an offer or an announcement. Optionally straight from your catalog or channel

steps.title: PRIZMA
steps.desc: The AI researches the topic, aims the text at real search queries and your region, and produces the selected formats

steps.title: You review
steps.desc: You check the output. You set how much approval you want: fully automatic, partial, or every post individually

steps.title: Published
steps.desc: Your posts go out automatically across all your channels, following your rules

showcase.heading: See it in practice.
showcase.subtitle: One topic. Three finished posts, ready to publish.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.lead: The price depends on the number of channels, the formats and the languages. For orientation:

items.label: Setup
items.desc: Analysis of your tone, connection of the channels and first content for review.

items.label: Operation
items.desc: Ongoing creation and publication in the agreed formats, released under your rules.

pricing.note: All prices are exclusive of statutory VAT. Separate terms apply to agencies and resellers.

trust.heading: Data protection and operations
trust.lead: PRIZMA processes your company content: products, offers, dates and announcements. Access to customer records is not required.

items.title: Contracting party and servers in the EU
items.desc: The contracting party is a company based in Bielefeld and the servers are located within the EU. Contracts, invoicing and support are handled from Germany.

items.title: Processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR
items.desc: We provide a data processing agreement, tailored to how the system is actually used in your company.

items.title: Processing to your specification
items.desc: By default, processing runs on our infrastructure. On request we use a European provider or install the system on a server of your own.

items.title: Approval and control
items.desc: You define which content is published automatically and which is reviewed beforehand. Your content is used to train AI models only with your consent.

cta.heading: Access on request.

contacts.heading: Direct contact
contacts.ai_note: Your call is answered around the clock by our AI phone assistant. It notes what you need, books an appointment and passes everything on. At the start of the call it states that you are speaking to an AI system. If you would rather not, simply send us an email.
